description: Project errors monitoring in real time: direct calls and an ILogger provider. For Serilog, NLog and log4net install BugsRadar.Serilog, BugsRadar.NLog or BugsRadar.Log4Net: each brings this package with it
releaseNotes: 3.0.0.6: fixes builder.Logging.AddBugsRadar(), which threw ArgumentException at startup in 3.0.0.1-3.0.0.5 ("Implementation type cannot be 'ILoggerProvider'"); the provider is registered under its own type now. If your application uses the ILogger provider, update: no earlier 3.0.0.x starts with it. Property names are sent as you wrote them; until now the package turned OrderId into orderId. Only the package's own log categories are kept out of the reports, BugsRadar.Client and the handlers of its HttpClient (BugsRadarClient.IsOwnCategory); other categories that start with BugsRadar, your own BugsRadar.* namespace for one, were dropped before and are reported now. BugsRadar.Serilog, BugsRadar.NLog and BugsRadar.Log4Net are released with the same version. 3.0.0.5: no code changes; the author of the package is now BistriySpzoo, the same as the owner on nuget.org. 3.0.0.4: no code changes; the README and the package links point to the new documentation pages at bugsradar.com. 3.0.0.3: the Serilog sink moved to its own package, BugsRadar.Serilog, and this package no longer depends on Serilog. If you use WriteTo.BugsRadar, add BugsRadar.Serilog: the method and the namespace BugsRadar.Extensions.Serilog are unchanged. New packages: BugsRadar.NLog (an NLog target) and BugsRadar.Log4Net (a log4net appender). 3.0.0.2: SendAsync and SendExceptionAsync are removed. They completed only after the event had been delivered, so awaiting one in a catch block put a network round trip into the caller's path; Send and SendException already queue the event and return at once, with the same duplicate filtering, repeat aggregation and retries. Use FlushAsync (or Dispose) before a short-lived process exits. 3.0.0.1: uses API v3 (API v2 is shut down); the package major version now matches the API version. Versions below 3.0.0.1 no longer deliver error reports and are not supported. New: one event model (BugsRadarEvent) for direct calls, an ILogger provider (builder.Logging.AddBugsRadar()) and a Serilog sink (WriteTo.BugsRadar); events are queued and sent in the background, repeats of the same error are folded into one request with a count, duplicates across entry points are dropped. Delivery problems are written to ILogger. Targets .NET Standard 2.0; dependency floors: Microsoft.Extensions.Http 8.0, Serilog 4.4, Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.4. The package no longer depends on ASP.NET Core: if your app calls AddNewtonsoftJson and relied on BugsRadar 1.x to bring it in, reference Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.NewtonsoftJson directly.
